question: element.cloneNode(true) kya karta hai?
options: Element ka deep copy banata hai (saare children ke saath)
explanation: cloneNode(true) deep clone hai — element aur uske saare children copy hote hain. cloneNode(false) sirf element copy karta hai, children nahi.

question: DocumentFragment ka kya fayda hai?
options: Saare elements ek baar mein DOM mein add karte hain — performance better
explanation: Fragment ek temporary container hai. Saare elements pehle fragment mein add karo, phir fragment ko DOM mein. Isse sirf ek reflow hota hai — multiple DOM operations se better.

question: element.remove() kya karta hai?
options: Element ko DOM se hata deta hai
explanation: .remove() element ko directly DOM se delete kar deta hai. Purane tareeke mein parent.removeChild() use hota tha — .remove() simpler hai.

question: innerHTML = '' karne se kya hota hai?
options: Element ka saara content delete ho jaata hai
explanation: innerHTML = '' se element ka content khali ho jaata hai but element itself rehta hai. Element bhi hatana ho toh .remove() use karo.
